releaseNotes: DukanBILL Desktop v1.9.21 — Full app rebrand from MargPOS to DukanBILL across all screens, navbar, invoices, reports, login, settings, and installer. Includes all Phase 3-5 features: Purchase Entry decimals, Stock Write-off/Adjustment, Supplier Ledger & Payments, Aging Report, Dashboard Quick-Access, Batch/Expiry Tracking.
